summary: Iteration 19 verified OpenAI/Anthropic BYO-key routing and settings UI. Historical privileged login details were removed after the 2026-09-14 security rotation.
backend_tests_run: 9/9 PASSED in tests/test_iter19_byo_llm.py. 75/75 PASSED regression (34 billing + 37 iter17 + 4 iter18).
critical_code_review_comments: resolve_provider_and_key precedence in writing_agent.py works correctly: preferred+own-key > any-own-key > preferred-on-Emergent-key. Note: the docstring says 'BYO key, unlimited' at step 1 and 2 which matches server.py behaviour (is_byo bypasses quota check and refund). Good.

Key validation on Anthropic key requires 'sk-' prefix + >=20 chars — real Anthropic keys start with 'sk-ant-' so the 'sk-' prefix accepts them, but the validation would also accept an OpenAI-style key in the anthropic slot. Not a security issue (LLM call will fail at Anthropic API), but consider tightening to 'sk-ant-' for anthropic-key endpoint if desired. Non-blocking.
server.py now 3147 lines — carrying forward iter17/18 recommendation to split into routers/{agent,billing,audiobook,byo_llm}.py. Non-blocking for ship.
test_credentials: Privileged credentials removed after security rotation. Iter19 backend tests register fresh test_iter19_*@example.com users on the fly.
seed_data_creation: Per-run: ~6 fresh test_iter19_* users + docs. Two of them get a fake sk-aaaa... OpenAI key inserted directly into Mongo users collection to simulate BYO — no real API spend.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The new endpoints live at /api/auth/me/llm-providers (PUBLIC), PUT/DELETE /api/auth/me/openai-key, PUT/DELETE /api/auth/me/anthropic-key, PUT /api/auth/me/preferred-provider. Resolver in writing_agent.py::resolve_provider_and_key returns (provider, model, api_key, is_byo). Both /api/ai/agent/chat and /api/ai/agent/command now include provider+model+byo_key in successful responses. BYO key skips both agent_check_and_charge and agent_refund_charge (the whole quota accounting is bypassed when is_byo=True). Frontend: SettingsPage.js at /settings route, Dashboard header has data-testid='settings-link-dashboard'. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter19_byo_llm.py is fully reusable for regression.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Implementation matches spec exactly.
